info.name: Amadeus Hotel Content Hotel Media API

params.name: hotelIds
params.description: Amadeus property codes (8 characters). Up to 20 hotel IDs per request.

params.name: category
params.description: Filter media by category. Options: EXTERIOR, LOBBY, ROOM, RESTAURANT, POOL, SPA, GYM, MEETING_ROOM, COMMON_AREA.

params.name: format
params.description: Preferred image format. Options: JPEG, PNG, WEBP.

items.docs: Returns media assets (images, videos) for one or more hotels in the Amadeus inventory. Media includes exterior shots, lobby photos, room images, restaurant photos, and amenity images categorized by type.
